evals.prompt: 実験結果を report.html にまとめて、shunk031-writing-telegraph で本文を短い骨子箇条書きにしてください。作業中の進捗と完了報告は普通の会話文で知らせてください。
evals.expected_output: The HTML report body uses a concise hierarchical bullet outline. Progress updates and the completion message remain ordinary conversational prose rather than being reformatted as report bullets.
assertions: The response applies the telegraph bullet style to the requested report deliverable rather than only using that style in progress or completion messages.
